name: Transmuted Anatomy

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Your Speed increases by 5 feet. Gain Advantage on saves against involuntary shape-shifting. After failing a Constitution save, use a Reaction to add 1d4, possibly succeeding instead; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
